content: Pe' efu qa pa' ƚeiƚe' qa pa' omeƚa's.

Ma' qa hi'wen iye na' wa'sji' ka' ewi'ƚ qii'ija in pakha' ƚunye'j na'l pa' jutsiqaxij: ewi'ƚ ke' efu yeqhinataji' ne' junu', qa ne' juwel qa t'otsipji', qa ha' yiwataji' k'oiji' qa doceji' (12) he' footekii.
Ke' efu iwkajitshen qa qi in yejtsi'le'kii qe yaats'etax in naqalkeyu'.

Ma' qa hi'wen iye na' wa'sji' ha' ewi'ƚ na'l iye pa' jutsiqaxij: ewi'ƚ ha' ƚeiƚe' qi qa s'e' iye. Qa he' ƚejiƚal qa wetsjuk tatsai (7) qa he' ƚeketsii qa week inyaqsii (10) qa he' ƚejiƚal qa week yiwataji' he' k'oiji' wit'iwatai.

Qa ke' ƚahatsji' qa yit'iji' in yetsinfik'i ha' ewi'ƚ ƚapk'as in wetshetk'ewi'ƚtaxju' ne' week footekii qa niwu'miiju'kii ha' sehe'. Ha' ƚeiƚe' qa teke'lenijupju' ƚ'ejuyi'jii ke' efu naqalkeyu' qe qa' netuj pa' ƚa's qu' nenekfik'i.

Ke' efu qa nekfik'i ha' ƚa's jukhew qa hikha' pakha' qu' netnek'enhe'yij pe' week witsetits qa pa' ƚek'u' qu' netnek'enhei qa nijket. Ke' efu ha' ƚa's in nekfik'i qa aje'eƚ wenilithin qa wetka'xii na' Dios qa na' ƚots'oji'la'x.
Qa kekhe'ƚe efu qa ilatiyek pa' ham i'ni'i', hikpa' i'ni' pa' hats yajileti'm pa' Dios qu' na'ni' kikhe'en qa' nekunhen iye, qa' namijets mil doscientos sesenta (1.260) neƚuts.
Qa in watlan na' wa'sji': ha' Miguel qa he' ƚaqa angelits watlani'ƚ ha' ƚeiƚe'. Ha' ƚeiƚe' qa he' ƚaqa angelits qa watlan,
qa nite'ƚe naxij, qa hats ham iye pa'qu' ƚetset'e na' wa'sji'.

Ma' qa tewumhiti'yiiju' ha' qi ƚeiƚe', hikha' pakhaa'ij q'oiq'oi qa ƚii inwo'met qa Satanás iye, hikha' yaqankii ha'ne week sehe' epji', qa tewumhiti'yiiju' ha' sehe' qa weeki'ƚ he' ƚaqa angelits in tewumhitiyi'ƚiiju'kii.

Ma' qa hepi'ye' pa' t'unik'i wit'ax na' wa'sji' in yit'ij: —Hane'ej hats yijat'axju' qa hats week wetets na' witiƚiye'j, qa na' witt'unha'x, qa na' witnek'enheye'j yatsat'axij na' Dios qa na' ƚewqiye'jji' na' ƚeqe Cristo, qe hats tewumhiti'yiiju' na' nifelji'ijtaxijkii pa' ƚunyejei ne' inejefetsipji', neƚuts qa najai in nifelji'ijtaxkii na' ƚ'ejuyi'jii na' Dios.
Nekhewe'en hats naxij, qa in naxij qa yit'iji' ke' ƚ'athits na' Kots'etax ƚa's, qa yit'iji' iye kekhewe' ƚe'lijei in tetfelij wete'm, ma' qa nite' naiƚewek, nite' nijiwe'yets in naxju'.

Qa hik ta'ƚijupi', e'ƚe'sitsi'iƚi'mkii, wasits, qa nekhewe' iye i'nji' nekhewe'en. ¡Hiyee' enewusits sehe' qa na' qi iweli'! qe na' inwo'met in te'nilit'iƚ ewetsju' qi in topo'oj na' ƚawak, qa nikfe'lets iye in ƚ'ajƚi'ij qu' netwejinhetiiƚe.—
Qa ha' ƚeiƚe' in we'twen in hats tewumhiti'yiiju' ha' sehe', ma' qa yijayankii ke' efu, hik kikhe' nekfik'i ha' Ƚa's jukhew.

Qa ke' efu qa testi'yij he' wetsjuk ƚefets ha' qi sinjena'x, hats'inha qu' nilatik'ui qa' nana'ya'ak'uyii na' q'oiq'oi na' ham i'ni'i', hik nakha' i'ni' na' ƚetset'ij, qa' hik nakha'a' qu' na'ni'kii qa' netkunhenhetii iye, qa' namijets wetshetk'ewi'ƚ qa ewi'ƚ k'itsje'm ininqapits.
Ha' q'oiq'oi qa tek'iyijfik'i ka' iweli' hik ƚunye'j na'aj haqqi' ƚ'anu'ui ke' efu, hats'inha in t'unik'i ha' haqqi' qa' netsinju' pe' efu.
Qa ha' sehe' qa yi'fen ke' efu, ha' sehe' qa yit'ij k'aj ha' ƚeji' qa timju' ka' iweli' tek'iitaxijfik'i ha' ƚeiƚe'.

Ha' ƚeiƚe' qa qi in nayu'um ke' efu, ma' qa ik qa' nakii qu' nawatlani'ƚ pekhewe' amanei ta'ƚets kikhe'en, hik pekhewe' tek'enets kekhewe' yit'ij na' Dios qa nite' yeqeku' iye kekhewe' iyetij ha' Jesús.
